text: The third is per-tag reputation: REP is not a fungible balance but a capability-scoped record maintained within skill domains, so that the institutional memory the substrate maintains about an agent is a profile of demonstrated competence rather than an undifferentiated score.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Paper 2 - Architecture of the Agentic Reputation Substrate (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7260278
